chain_words.nuance: to form a judgement about the quality of something
to examine and judge the merits of an argument
to examine a work and point out its strengths and weaknesses
to assess the value of something carefully and formally
to criticise something publicly and strongly as wrong

explanation: These words all describe judging the quality of a piece of work, from a neutral assessment to a public denunciation.

usage_notes.difference: 'Critique' means examining a work and weighing its strengths and weaknesses; 'denounce' means condemning it publicly and strongly as wrong.
